counterfactual_policy_matrix.pillar: Roads & Rail: Inland Port Freight Diversion
counterfactual_policy_matrix.trend_risk: Continued cargo volume growth at Inland Port Greer without arterial rail bypasses causes severe peak-hour gridlock on Highway 101, I-85, and Woodruff Road.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.policy_recommendation: Deploy grade-separated rail overpasses at critical freight choke points and construct dedicated heavy-truck staging spurs with smart signal priority.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.counterfactual_outcome: 34% decrease in local arterial intersection queuing and an 18% improvement in intermodal freight dispatch velocity.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.financial_impact: $14.2M annual savings in commercial freight idling and logistics delays.

counterfactual_policy_matrix.pillar: Land & Water: Targeted Urban Growth Boundaries (UGB)
counterfactual_policy_matrix.trend_risk: Unchecked low-density greenfield sprawl in South County (Simpsonville, Fountain Inn) stresses Greenville Water pumping heads and spikes impervious runoff.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.policy_recommendation: Implement high-density transit-oriented zoning along the Swamp Rabbit Trail network and Laurens Road, paired with tiered water impact fees on perimeter sprawl.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.counterfactual_outcome: Concentrated density lowers utility trunk-line expansion capital costs by 22% while preserving 14,200 acres of watershed absorption capacity.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.financial_impact: $38.5M avoided capital expenditure in perimeter sewer/water main extensions.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.lead_agency: Greenville County Planning Commission & Greenville Water

counterfactual_policy_matrix.pillar: Grid & Airport: GSP Logistics Clean Energy Microgrids
counterfactual_policy_matrix.trend_risk: Surging air freight and adjacent aerospace manufacturing drive Duke Energy Pelham/Mauldin substations to 91.8% capacity during 95°F+ heat peaks.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.policy_recommendation: Deploy a 45 MW utility-scale solar + BESS (Battery Energy Storage) microgrid on non-aeronautical airport property coupled with demand-response industrial contracts.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.counterfactual_outcome: Shaves 15% off peak substation draw, hedging against transmission line curtailments and brownout risks during summer heatwaves.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.financial_impact: $6.8M avoided substation transformer upgrade and peak demand tariffs.
counterfactual_policy_matrix.lead_agency: GSP Airport Authority & Duke Energy Carolinas
